summary: Kundarki complaints centre on waterlogged roads and drains, contaminated or low-pressure tap water and weak CHC services, while the Rs 3.65 crore road and drain works started in June 2026 are the main visible development.

positives.english: Road and drain works worth Rs 3.65 crore got their foundation stone in Kundarki
positives.hindi: कुंदरकी में सड़क और नाले के कामों का शिलान्यास हो गया है
positives.basis: MLA Ramveer Singh performed bhoomi pujan and shilanyas for projects worth Rs 3 crore 65 lakh on Monday (article dated 9 June 2026): Banhpur to Alirajapur road Rs 61.21 lakh, Masebi Rasulpur to Tahrpur Doyam and Basera Khas link road Rs 74.97 lakh, Moradabad-Ganwa-Bulandshahr road drain and special repairs Rs 229.40 lakh. Article gives no completion date.

positives.english: Branches cut from the high-tension line, so the fear of a breakdown is somewhat less
positives.hindi: हाईटेंशन लाइन की टहनियां कटीं, तार टूटने का डर कुछ कम हुआ
positives.basis: Maintenance on the 132 kV line from Bhaisod power station to Kundarki and Jaitwara substations (article dated 4 Oct 2026, outage on Saturday 3 Oct for five and a half hours): tree branches near the line trimmed to prevent breakdown in storms. Junior engineer Jayveer Singh says breakdown risk has greatly reduced. Article does not say voters appreciated it.

positives.english: Clinics and a pathology lab running without registration were sealed
positives.hindi: बिना पंजीकरण चल रहे क्लीनिक और लैब पर सील लगी
positives.basis: Health team led by Kundarki CHC medical superintendent Dr Saurabh Bartariya sealed two unregistered clinics (Mohanpur village, Kundarki block), a maternity centre in Kundarki town and a pathology lab in Dingarpur village; operators could not show valid papers (article dated 17 Sep 2026). Mohanpur and Dingarpur membership in the AC not confirmed.

positives.english: *PM SHRI composite school runs in Ward 8 of Kundarki nagar panchayat
positives.hindi: *कुंदरकी नगर में पीएम श्री कंपोजिट स्कूल चल रहा है
positives.basis: Inference: the 17 Jul 2026 Amar Ujala article names the PM Shri Composite School as one of the landmarks in Ward 8, Nagar Panchayat Kundarki. No source shows residents praising the school; this is listed only as an existing public facility.

positives.english: *OPD runs at Kundarki CHC and medicines are available
positives.hindi: *सीएचसी में ओपीडी चलती है और दवा मिल जाती है
positives.basis: Inference: the 8 Sep 2026 Amar Ujala article reports officials saying medicines are sufficient and doctors sit in OPD on time. This is an official claim, not resident praise, and the same article reports serious gaps (see negatives).

negatives.english: For four years contaminated water has reached household tanks, and it is not fit to drink
negatives.hindi: चार साल से घरों की टंकियों में दूषित पानी आ रहा है, पीने लायक नहीं
negatives.basis: Ward 8 of Nagar Panchayat Kundarki, over 5,000 residents: main problem is contaminated drinking water supply, reaching household tanks for four years; residents say officials' assurances have not solved it (article dated 17 Jul 2026). No official action is quoted.

negatives.english: No X-ray at the CHC, no eye doctor for two years, and patients keep wandering
negatives.hindi: सीएचसी पर एक्स-रे नहीं, दो साल से आंख के डॉक्टर नहीं, मरीज भटकते हैं
negatives.basis: Kundarki CHC (article dated 8 Sep 2026): X-ray technician absent because he was sent to Bilari CHC for three days of duty; no eye specialist for two years, transferred to Sambhal; specialist doctor, pharmacist and health worker posts vacant. Administration says a request for an eye specialist was already sent to higher officials.

negatives.english: Kundarki-Haryana link road gets waterlogged in rain, and potholes injure bike riders
negatives.hindi: कुंदरकी-हरियाणा संपर्क मार्ग पर बारिश में पानी और कीचड़, गड्ढों में गिरकर चोट
negatives.basis: Kundarki-Haryana link road (article dated 26 Aug 2026): poor drainage causes waterlogging and mud, deep potholes have formed, bike riders have fallen and been injured, farmers wade through dirty water. Road links 12 villages to Kundarki town; the article names 11 of them. A nagar panchayat councillor says PWD was asked for road construction and no action has been taken. Village membership in the AC not confirmed.

negatives.english: Tap water pressure is weak in ward nine, and handpump water is dirty
negatives.hindi: वार्ड नौ में नल में पानी का प्रेशर कम, हैंडपंप से गंदा पानी आता है
negatives.basis: Ward 9 of Nagar Panchayat Kundarki (article dated 18 Jul 2026): supply in most homes arrives at low pressure so chores go unfinished and supply cuts out; handpumps give dirty water; lanes are narrow and pothole-filled; no response from officials or the nagar panchayat reported.

negatives.english: Rain floods the power station yard, a wall has collapsed and transformers are exposed
negatives.hindi: बारिश में बिजलीघर परिसर में पानी भरा, दीवार टूटी, ट्रांसफार्मर खुले पड़े हैं
negatives.basis: Kundarki power station (article dated 28 Aug 2026): yard is lower than the ground around it, so rain stays; water collects near the SDO office, JE office and cash counter; one side of the boundary wall collapsed and is not rebuilt, leaving high-capacity transformers exposed. SDO Satish Kumar says a permanent fix is possible only after the rains end. Power station is in Kundarki town; AC boundary check not separately confirmed.

notes: Identity (AC 29, Kundarki, Moradabad, general seat) confirmed from the Wikipedia AC page, which lists no extent. Wikipedia and the EC-linked pages give no tehsil or village list, and the IndiaStat Kundarki Factbook PDF could not be read. Village-level sources conflict on whether some Bilari tehsil villages belong to Kundarki or Bilari, so the 12 villages on the Kundarki-Haryana road are unconfirmed. The Jul 8 2026 Amar Ujala article quotes the MLA saying Kundarki has only one nagar panchayat in the assembly, which supports treating Nagar Panchayat Kundarki (Wards 2, 3, 8, 9, 10 named in local reports) as inside the AC. Ward-level MLA demands from 8 Jul 2026 (CC roads and drains at five spots in Wards 3 and 10, 13 roads demanded on 21 Aug 2026, Rs 50 lakh for Valmiki Mohalla pond in Ward 2) are not used as negatives because they are demands, not confirmed facts. Positives 4 and 5 are flagged inference because no source records residents appreciating them. The 5 Sep 2026 fever death in Pandiya village was left out because the village's AC membership is unconfirmed. Water and electricity items are drawn from single Amar Ujala reports; a field check of Ward 8 water tanks, the power station yard and the Kundarki-Haryana road would confirm current status. Local Hindi searches for Kundarki stray cattle, sugarcane dues and schools returned nothing Kundarki-specific, so no negatives were drawn from them.
